video.title: Meet Snap — the studio platform for photographers

copyProvenance: All claims drawn verbatim or near-verbatim from docs/SNAP-30-DAY-LAUNCH-STRATEGY.md truth sheet + apps/snap product copy. No superlatives, no numbers outside the sheet.

scenes.narration: Meet Snap — the studio platform for photographers. Bookings, galleries, contracts, payments. One login, one bill, and zero percent commission. Ever.
scenes.note: Overview with stat cards + pipeline strip. Cursor drifts over stats, gentle scroll to pipeline/next sessions.

scenes.narration: It starts with one link. Your client picks a session, picks a time, pays the deposit. Booked — in under a minute.
scenes.note: Public booking page. Scroll to calendar, click Oct 6 so time slots appear. Fallback selector: text=6 times free's parent day.

scenes.narration: Every new inquiry lands in Leads — triage, reply, and convert, right next to your bookings.
scenes.note: Leads table (6 seeded inquiries, new/replied/converted). Replaces inbox shot: staging inbox thread contains QA residue (WEB-307 test text, DELIVERY FAILED badges).

scenes.narration: Booked work moves down a pipeline built for shoots. Every job carries its files, gallery, invoices, and contracts.
scenes.note: Kanban with mixed states, then click Sofia Marino card -> project hub (files/gallery/payments/contracts tabs).

scenes.narration: When the shoot wraps, choose from ten designer templates and preview each one with your photos. Live.
scenes.note: Template Studio picker (ten cards with previews). Click Editorial Wedding 'Preview with your photos' -> styled preview opens.

scenes.narration: Clients open a verified link, protected by a six-digit code. They favorite their picks, share the gallery, and order prints.
scenes.note: Public client-side gallery (editorial styling). Scroll the grid, open the wedding-couple lightbox. Fallback: text=wedding-couple.jpg.

scenes.narration: And payments go straight to your own Stripe. Snap never holds your money, and never takes a cut. That fee goes to Stripe — never to us.
scenes.note: Transactions: Collected $400 summary card + succeeded row.

scenes.narration: Snap. Your studio, in focus. Start free — twenty gigabytes, no credit card.
scenes.note: Visual: brief dashboard hold under VO; the outro sting card carries the CTA text. Cards: intro 'Meet Snap', outro 'Start free — snap.webcules.com'.
